messages:
ashley: Kicking off a quick PrivSec sanity check for the new ap-southeast3 GPU cluster (prod pool). Need IAM/Secrets/KMS(HSM) validation + network egress sanity before handoff to ops. Can folks run the checks below and paste short results here? :eyes:

ashley: Preflight (run these where appropriate):
```
1) IAM role bindings: infra/gpu-node, infra/gpu-admin, infra/gpu-deployer
   // list roles and attached policies (gcloud/iam or aws iam)
2) KMS/HSM: describe key, ensure key policy allows node SA & rotation enabled
   // aws kms describe-key --key-id <arn> OR gcloud kms keys describe 
3) Secrets: verify secret exists in k8s, check labels/annotations and KMS envelope encryption
   // kubectl -n redwood get secret gpu-kms-creds -o yaml
4) Privilege boundary / IAM boundary policy applied to deployer roles (boundary v2.1)
5) Network: confirm node egress rules (deny 0.0.0.0/0 for worker subnet, allow apt/yum repos + registry egress)
6) Smoke test: small inference job that exercises KV cache and KMS unwrap
```

mike: On it. Running IAM checks now. Will paste quick diffs.

mike: IAM -> infra/gpu-node has AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly, but missing kms:Decrypt on inline policy. infra/gpu-admin ok. infra/gpu-deployer missing iam:PassRole to the node role (needed for rollout jobs).

ashley: ack. Can you open a minimal fix PR to add kms:Decrypt to infra/gpu-node and PassRole to deployer? Tag @security for review.

kevin: KMS/HSM check: Key exists in the customer HSM cluster, rotation on, but key policy lacks the node service account ARN we use for node agents. Also the HSM wrapper is showing a slightly higher latency (14ms) than eu regions ~10ms — just FYI for autoscaler SLOs.

kevin: Command I ran: `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-3:123:key/abcd` -> policy missing `sts:AssumeRole` entry for `arn:aws:iam::123:role/infra-gpu-node`

ashley: thanks. Can you add the SA and re-run? Also file an action to validate latency impact with autoscaler team.

sre-bot: automated-privsec-smoke v1.2: results -> kms=PASS (key reachable), secrets=FAIL (gpu-kms-creds missing annotation `redwood.com/encrypted-by:kms`), iam=WARN (missing kms:Decrypt on node role), network=PASS (egress limited to registries/repos). Full log: /ci/artifacts/2012345678/privsec-smoke.log

sophia: +1 on the quota callout — we're still waiting on GPU quota bump for ap-southeast3 (requested yesterday). If quota isn't approved before handoff we should block prod cutover. Also note cost: this region's spot reclaim rate historically higher; recommend reserving a small dedicated pool for latency-sensitive workloads.

ashley: OK, summary / next steps:
- mike: PR to add kms:Decrypt to infra/gpu-node and iam:PassRole to infra/gpu-deployer (assign to @mike).
- kevin: add node SA to KMS key policy and re-run envelope unwrap test.
- eng-sre: follow up on autoscaler SLOs for 14ms HSM lat (ticket SRE-4123).
- ops: hold prod cutover until GPU quota confirmed (sophia).
- security: review PR and boundary v2.1 compatibility (notify @security).
- me: I'll create a short handoff doc with checks and attach prestage artifacts + smoke logs.

mike: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/542 (small policy additions). cc @security

kevin: Updated KMS key policy, re-ran unwrap, success. `openssl` wrapper lat still ~13-14ms but unwrap success. Re-run smoke: secrets still failing annotations — looks like CI secret sync job didn't label the secret.

ashley: who owns secret-sync? @devex? If it's a one-off we can patch secret and then reconcile with sync job.

sophia: devex is on it, will patch secret & push a fix to sync job. Also pinging cloud-quotas for GPU increase.

ashley: great. Once PR merged and secrets annotated, I'll re-run the smoke test and then handoff to oncall + security for final sign-off. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
